text:
sophia: FYI bringing up orca-lite-embed v0.9 int8 on staging. Quick smoke: recall@1 on short-queries (<=6 tokens) dropped ~12% vs prod-embed. silhouette down ~0.07. full eval attached to PR. anyone seen compact int8 short-tail regressions like this?

raj: can you paste the dataset and exact eval split? how are we defining short-queries?

sophia: short-queries = token_count <= 6 from web-qa holdout (5k queries). eval command I used: `python eval_emb.py --model orca-lite-embed --quant int8 --holdout short`

eval-bot: automated run finished. metrics: recall@1: 0.61 (prod 0.69) recall@5: 0.82 (prod 0.84) silhouette: 0.32 -> 0.25. notes: per-channel int8 applied, faiss index (IVF4096,Flat). logs: /artifacts/3532109876/logs.json

ian: are we L2-normalizing prior to indexing? int8 can amplify scale mismatches. share full pipeline please.

sophia: pipeline: encode -> l2norm -> quantize (per-channel). I also tried quantize before norm to sanity-check, only minor diff though.

monica: try cosine lookup (dot on normalized) vs raw dot on dequantized floats. sometimes dequant scaling mismatch causes rank flips. also try per-channel recalibration.

raj: can you paste 1-2 failing NN examples (query + prod top1 vs int8 top1)? helps root cause. :thumbsup:

sophia: quick examples:
`query: "how to reset password"`
prod top1: doc_id_453 (exact match)
int8 top1: doc_id_132 (different intent)
embedding diffs show heavy clamp on dims 120-127 after quantization.

ian: I'll run a dequant vs float cos delta check with `--no-clamp` and `--dump-vecs` to inspect per-dim scale. if it's scale skew we should see big cosine changes on those queries.

monica: also try PQ(4byte) as a comparison; sometimes uniform int8 loses fine-grained neighborhood info on compact models.

sophia: submitted re-run as job 3532110001 with per-channel recalib and a --no-clamp variant. will post results.

eval-bot: job 3532110001 completed. summary: recall@1 short-queries: float32 baseline 0.70, int8-no-clamp 0.68, int8-perchannel-recalib 0.69, PQ(4byte) float32 0.69. per-query diffs attached at /artifacts/3532110001/diffs.csv

raj: recalibration helps a lot, narrowing gap. next steps: add per-channel scale calibration to quant pipeline, add short-query holdout test to CI.

sophia: agreed. I'll open PR with per-channel calibration + a tiny unit test on the short holdout and include a note about checking clamp thresholds. thanks all.
